title: School's out for Christmas
label: confirmed
source_name: Manchester City Council school term dates
explain: Free school meals stop for 11 school days. Lunch at home for two children costs about £4 each a day.

history.change: Your food shopping went up about £45 a week over last Christmas

suggestion.title: Sign up for free holiday meals
suggestion.text: Manchester's holiday activities and food clubs are free for children on free school meals. They give a hot lunch on most weekdays.

title: Christmas presents and food
label: likely
explain: Last December you spent extra on presents at Smyths Toys, Argos and Primark.

suggestion.title: Put a little aside each week
suggestion.text: Keep a small amount back from each pay day until mid-December.

title: Winter energy direct debit
label: likely
source_name: Your Ember Energy payments last winter
explain: Last year Ember Energy raised your direct debit from £84 to £112 in December. It went back down in April.

suggestion.title: Check your Warm Home Discount
suggestion.text: Households on Universal Credit in England get £150 off their winter electricity bill. It is usually automatic. Check it has been applied.

title: Energy price change in January
label: forecast
explain: The energy price cap is forecast to rise from 1 January. Ofgem confirms it in late November.

suggestion.title: Put a little aside each week
suggestion.text: A small amount each week from now covers the higher bill.

title: Council tax goes up in April
label: likely
explain: Councils can raise council tax by up to 4.99% a year without a local vote. Manchester has done this for three years.

suggestion.title: Check Council Tax Support
suggestion.text: People on Universal Credit in Manchester can get up to 82.5% off council tax. Apply on the council website.

title: Water bills go up in April
label: forecast
explain: Ofwat set water bills to rise every April until 2030.

suggestion.title: Ask about a cheaper water tariff
suggestion.text: United Utilities has a lower tariff for people on low incomes. You can apply online or by phone.

title: Mobile bill rises in April
label: confirmed
explain: Your contract says the price goes up £1.50 a month every April.

suggestion.title: Look at social tariffs
suggestion.text: Ofcom lists cheaper mobile and broadband deals for people on Universal Credit.

title: Car insurance renewal
label: likely
source_name: Your Shield Car Insurance payment last March
explain: You paid Shield Car Insurance £548 on 12 March 2026. It renews once a year.

suggestion.title: Start a renewal pot
suggestion.text: A small amount each week means the renewal is covered in March.

title: Universal Credit goes up in April
label: confirmed
explain: Benefits go up each April in line with prices from the September before.

suggestion.title: Good news
suggestion.text: Nothing to do. This is paid automatically.

title: Prepayment meter standing charge change
label: forecast
explain: Standing charges for prepayment meters are changing.

suggestion.title: Top up a little extra
suggestion.text: Add a little more each week.
